resolution: Checked the five hand-parsed doc.blob commands against what the seat already covers. package info covered the first exactly (header counts on the same camper, vc=2718); the other four had no verb, so they became package ranges, package triangles, and package compare. ranges reports per-range triangles, distinct authored GROUPS, bbox and part name — the group count is what separates a quad mesh from soup inside one part, which ranges:6 alone cannot say, and the live run reproduces the transcript's first row lo:0 hi:290 tris:246 groups:130 exactly while adding the part name the hand reader could not reach. triangles decodes saved corner positions AND uvs from stride columns 6 and 7, the detail a hand reader gets wrong after getting positions right, and triangle 700 reproduces the transcript's floats with group, region and material attached. compare diffs two SAVED packages, distinct from the existing diff which is saved versus resident. All of the originals hardcoded RJMD v4's 40-byte header and at = 40 + vc*32, and both v4 and v5 packages exist on disk, so that layout is silently wrong for half the models. Verification surfaced two things worth the user's attention: Compact_Car_001's saved document is currently rejected with [invalid-edge-logical-id] because an edge region named test refers outside the saved logical-vertex table, and my own first compare branch reported a weaker reason for the second package than info does, which would have sent a reader to the wrong file — that now matches info's diagnostic quality. meshDoc 30 tests pass with 7 new, seatApi 77.
